dispatch-recommendation.title: Intelligent recommendation
dispatch-recommendation.setup_install: Install the current Suma native agent runtime and use its dedicated dispatch recommendation entry.
dispatch-recommendation.setup_configure: Configure allowed deployments through Go Runner model_deployments. Provider keys remain in Go; select the single analysis model and budget in the interface.
dispatch-recommendation.setup_register: Use the existing tool observation and registration flow to verify the current version and dedicated read-only recommendation capability, then use it from task dispatch.
dispatch-recommendation.setup_policy: This analysis only compares frozen candidates, makes one model call and has no workspace tools. Human adoption creates the standard preview, which still needs an explicit start. It does not change expert responsibilities or approve a task.
dispatch-recommendation.intro: Compare real tool and model alternatives for this task. Review an editable suggestion, then create a preview. Starting execution still requires a separate confirmation.
dispatch-recommendation.read_only: You can view candidates and history. Creating an analysis or adopting a suggestion requires project write access.
dispatch-recommendation.draft_guard: Finish or cancel the recommendation draft first. Keep and reconcile any operation with an unknown outcome.
dispatch-recommendation.invalid_read: The response does not match this task, candidate scope or analysis version. Refresh and review.
dispatch-recommendation.invalid_choice: The candidate, parameters or reason do not meet the frozen scope and budget. Adjust them or prepare a new analysis.
dispatch-recommendation.invalid_constrai: Enter valid execution limits. A required budget needs a token or cost limit.
dispatch-recommendation.refresh_failed: The refreshed read is unconfirmed. The draft and original operation are retained.
dispatch-recommendation.access_changed: Access changed. Protected recommendation details have been cleared.
dispatch-recommendation.unconfirmed: The previous result is unconfirmed. Adoption is paused.
dispatch-recommendation.original_hint: Recover the original request and key, without creating another analysis or preview.
dispatch-recommendation.locator_not_save: The local locator could not be saved. Reopen the original record from this task's recommendation history.
dispatch-recommendation.analysis_created: Read-only analysis registered. The development task has not started.
dispatch-recommendation.constraints_hint: These constraints are frozen into the candidate source. Parameters can be adjusted within them; a budget change needs a new analysis.
dispatch-recommendation.hard_budget: Require candidates with platform budget enforcement
dispatch-recommendation.budget_boundary: Reservations use context capacity × steps and the total output allowance, rather than an exact tokenizer or a guarantee of the provider's final invoice. Observe-only tools cannot satisfy a hard budget.
dispatch-recommendation.analysis_model_h: This independent model call compares the candidates. It is separate from the development task's model and has its own single-call binding and usage.
dispatch-recommendation.no_profile: No available dedicated recommender is present in the loaded inventory. Check tool configuration or continue paging.
dispatch-recommendation.profile_scope: Tool profiles loaded: {{loaded}} / {{total}}. Only dedicated read-only recommender profiles are shown here.
dispatch-recommendation.model_consent: I agree to send this task and the frozen candidate context to the selected analysis model and use its budget.
dispatch-recommendation.state_hint.runni: This run only analyzes candidates. It does not execute the development task.
dispatch-recommendation.state_hint.recon: Review the original run and operation. Completion is unconfirmed, and no call is repeated automatically.
dispatch-recommendation.state_hint.faile: This analysis produced no valid suggestion. Its original run and output remain traceable.
dispatch-recommendation.state_hint.ready: This is a model suggestion. No execution preview for the target task has been created.
dispatch-recommendation.state_hint.adopt: The standard execution preview was created. Open that plan to check whether execution has actually started.
dispatch-recommendation.basis_changed: The task, workflow, inventory, model or authority basis changed. This suggestion cannot be adopted; the draft remains available for review.
dispatch-recommendation.events_reconnect: Reconnecting; refresh the original analysis if needed
dispatch-recommendation.events_invalid: Event data could not be verified. Refresh the original analysis.
dispatch-recommendation.events_forbidden: Access to analysis events was lost
dispatch-recommendation.adopt_boundary: Adoption rechecks versions, inventory, model, rates and authority, then creates the standard preview. It does not start execution or change expert responsibilities.
dispatch-recommendation.usage_boundary: Usage comes from the original analysis run and its binding evidence. Unreported does not mean zero, and it does not establish settlement of a provider invoice.
dispatch-recommendation.history_scope: Loaded on this page: {{loaded}} / {{total}}. This page is not the full history.
dispatch-recommendation.coverage_complet: Current snapshot: {{examined}} / {{total}} profiles examined, {{count}} candidates captured (limit {{limit}}).
dispatch-recommendation.coverage_partial: Candidate scope is truncated: {{examined}} / {{total}} profiles examined, {{count}} candidates retained (limit {{limit}}). This is not all tools.
dispatch-recommendation.coverage_time: Candidate observation: {{at}}. Adoption and start still recheck current conditions.
dispatch-recommendation.no_candidates: No candidate in the captured scope meets these constraints. Adjust the constraints or check tool configuration.
dispatch-recommendation.candidate_bounda: Availability is an inventory observation, not provider health or performance certification. Missing cost and performance data remains unknown.
dispatch-recommendation.quote: Platform rate {{currency}} · v{{version}} (not a provider invoice)
dispatch-recommendation.frozen_limits: Up to {{steps}} steps; total output allowance {{output}} tokens.
dispatch-recommendation.inherited: Not specified separately; current platform policy applies
dispatch-recommendation.reason.invalid_r: The recommendation request does not meet its contract.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.profile: Choose an available dedicated read-only recommender.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.source_ch: The recommendation basis changed. Read the candidates again.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.no_candid: No eligible execution candidate meets the current constraints.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.consent: Confirm the analysis model and context use.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.invalid_o: The model output did not pass the fixed candidate contract.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.version: The recommendation version changed. Refresh before deciding.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.unknown: Reconcile this analysis against its original run.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.failed: The read-only analysis did not complete successfully.
dispatch-recommendation.reason.other: The analysis returned another reason. Expand its original details for review.
dispatch-recommendation.test_bindings_re: The selected independent tests will be checked against this recommendation’s actual development worker before adoption.
dispatch-recommendation.test_bindings_ot: These test selections belong to a different or unconfirmed workflow. Use the formal preview below to review them.
dispatch-recommendation.test_bindings_ch: The selected independent test tool changed or shares this recommendation’s development worker. Review the test tools in the formal preview.
